author: Author
title: Title
page_not_found_message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
empty_library_help: Add a novel to start your library.
no_chapters: The first chapter is still ahead.
revised_hint: The saved draft differs from the published version. Readers see it after you publish a new version.
published_notice: This saved version will appear in your next static export.
unpublished_notice: Removed from future exports. Rebuild to update an existing site.
save_hint: Save before leaving this chapter. ⌘S / Ctrl+S to save.
draft_hint: Only published revisions appear in a static export.
metadata_hint: Changes to these details appear in the next export of a published novel.
confirm_discard: Discard your unsaved changes and reload the file from disk?
leave_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
characters_empty: Introduce the people at the heart of your story. Add a name, a role, and a short introduction for each main character.
characters_hint: These introductions are for readers. Keep them spoiler-free; changes appear in the next export of a published novel.
remove_character_confirm: Remove this character introduction from the novel?
delete_novel_hint: Remove this novel and all its chapters from the library? The complete folder will be kept in .trash/novels/ inside your content folder for manual recovery.
delete_chapter_hint: Remove this chapter from the novel? Its saved Markdown and metadata history will be kept for manual recovery.
delete_export_hint: It will be excluded from future static builds. Rebuild and redeploy to update an existing published site.
delete_save_first: Save or discard unsaved text and resolve recovered drafts before deleting this chapter.
word_count_hint: Chapter text only. Each Chinese character counts as one; other words are counted by letter or number groups. Markdown formatting, math formulas, images, and link URLs are excluded.
organize_hint: Move chapters or whole volumes with the arrows. Use the destination selector to move chapters into or out of a volume. Numbers follow the reading order. Changes apply only when saved.
group_hint: Start with a standalone chapter, then move other chapters into the volume. To create a volume with a new first chapter, use New chapter on the novel page.
empty_volume_confirm: Moving this last chapter will also remove its empty volume. Continue?
empty_volume_delete: This is the last chapter in its volume. Deleting it will also remove the empty volume.
relation_mutual: Mutual — the same both ways, such as friends or siblings
relationships_empty: Map how your characters are connected. Each relationship draws a line between two people.
relationships_need_characters: Add at least two characters to map their relationships.
graph_hint: Select a person to highlight their connections. Drag to rearrange.
category_hint: Type a new name to create a category.
categories_hint: Categories group characters on the novel page, in this order. Removing a category keeps its characters, without a category.
categories_empty: No categories yet. Add one below, or type a category when editing a character.
